main_text.p: Lites accendere. Pahel חָרָה Idem. Aph. אַחֲרִי Idem.
Ethpahel ִֽהִתְחָרָה Idem: Item Frangi, Rumpi: Et rupta est, Act.27.41. Reg.Et illisa est. Tremel. Et infixit se.
חֲרִינָא Chald. Æstus irae, Furor, Excandescentia. Syrè: Lis, contentio, disceptatio, cōtroversia. Plur. חֲרִינִין Controversiae, Lites, 1.ad Timoth.1.4.
חרט Ch. Poenitere, Poenitentiam agere, Resipiscere, לָא צָבַן לְמַחְרַט Nolunt poenitentiam agere, Cantic.5.4.
חַרְטוֹם Ch. Magus, Genethliacus. Plur. חַרְטָמִין.
חרך Ch. Aduri, Amburi, Inuri, Comburi. Ithpeh. אִתְחָרַךְ Idem. Exo.12.37. Jon. Dan.3.27. Genef. 21.15. in Jon.
מְחָרוּךְ Ch. Ustio, adustio, Exo.21.25. & Lev.10.2. Jon.
חַרְכָּא Ch. Fenestra, foramen, cancelli. Plur. חַרְכִּין, emphat. חַרְכַּיָּא.
חרל חוּרְלָא Ch. Urtica. Plur. const. חוּרְלֵי, Prov.24.31.

חרם אַחֲרִים Ch. & Syr. Anathematizare, anathematî, Internecioni Devovere, Confecrare, Devotum efficere. Hinc capiendum intransitivè, דִּלְמָא תְּחָרְמוּן, ut Hebraicè מִן תְּחָרִימוּ, Ne anathematizemini, Jos. 6.18. Ithpah. אִתְחָרַם Devotum esse, Devoveri.
חַרְמָא חרם Ch. & Syr. Anathema, devotio, devotū, res devota. Item Sagena, Rete, Habac.1.15.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek words are approximated; the scan is faint in places, and the Hebrew vowel points and the Syriac/Chaldee forms may be imprecise. The small Hebrew word at the lower right is a catchword-like marker and is recorded as the catchword. Some Latin words in the faint lower-left background are show-through and omitted.
